unsupported: Frankfort Plant Board (FPB) operates as a municipal utility in Frankfort, Kentucky, providing electric, water, and cable‑telecom services to the community.
Governed as a public board, it serves the capital city and surrounding areas with locally controlled infrastructure.
Residential and small‑business customers in the Frankfort service area make up the core subscriber base.
FPB emphasizes local customer service, bundled utility billing, and community ownership as differentiators.
The board notes that its integrated electric, water, and telecom operations allow coordinated infrastructure investment and a single point of contact for residents.

Known for: Local customer service and support; Bundled electric, water, and cable‑telecom billing; TV Everywhere streaming included with cable subscription; Stingray music channels (50 channels) streamable on mobile; Community solar project and energy‑efficiency programs
